paraphrase: Through association with the five sheaths the pure self appears as though made of them, as a crystal appears blue by association with a blue cloth.
notes: Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional or disputed).

original.text: bodho 'nyasādhanebhyo hi sākṣān mokṣaikasādhanam / pākasya vahnivaj jñānaṃ vinā mokṣo na sidhyati
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: Compared to other means, knowledge is the one direct means to liberation; as cooking is impossible without fire, liberation is impossible without knowledge.
notes: Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional or disputed).

original.text: avirodhitayā karma nāvidyāṃ vinivartayet / vidyāvidyāṃ nihanty eva tejas timirasaṅghavat
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: Action, not being opposed to ignorance, cannot remove it; knowledge destroys ignorance as light destroys the mass of darkness.
notes: Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional or disputed).

original.text: tāvat satyaṃ jagad bhāti śuktikārajataṃ yathā / yāvan na jñāyate brahma sarvādhiṣṭhānam advayam
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: The world appears real, like silver in the shell, as long as Brahman, the non-dual substratum of all, is not known.
notes: Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional or disputed).
